summary: OSLO MEDITASJON (org. no. 995 737 612) is an association (FLI) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-07-14. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Anders Fiskaa Kverneland; board chair: Anders Fiskaa Kverneland.
